name: canadapost-gui
description: Hardened local Canada Post tracking eligibility and late-delivery claim workflow.

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check renderer.js && node --check scripts/submit-claims.js && php -l scripts/get-tracking-cli.php && php -l scripts/import-est-history-cli.php && php -l scripts/import-shipping-history-cli.php
scripts.test: npm run check && php tests/eligibility-test.php && node tests/storage-test.js && node tests/claim-selection-test.js
